integrity: The proof is self-contained; finite exact checks and an independent audit have not been conflated. All computations are reproducible with Python standard library.
scientific_limitations: Exact rank of one independently entry-sparsified real two-column sketch only; not conditioning, subspace-isometry, arbitrary sketch orientations or general multi-column rank. Publication-priority comparisons are evidence-limited.
title: Optimal interior sparsity and a Lambert-W boundary layer for two-column signed sketches
